mapping.summary: Machine maintenance in BC: preventive schedules, work orders, requests, costs and reliability KPIs.
claims: Machine register with serial number, model, location and warranty
Preventive schedules generate work orders automatically by interval
Operators raise maintenance requests and the team is notified
Work orders track labour hours, parts and external service invoices into cost per activity and machine
Live dashboard with KPIs, team performance and a Gantt view
Built-in MTTR and MTBF metrics and SLA tracking
Technicians log time, notes and photos on jobs
Spare parts stock levels and thresholds tied to work order consumption
Manager role plus a lightweight requester role for operators
Email notifications to assigner, technician and requester
